message: 屋内プールの決闘！

name: Synn
message: 「Are you really okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no problem. You worry too much, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Calling him 'Synn' so naturally, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's great you're feeling better, right? Your color is completely back to normal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Almost brings a tear to my eye」

name: Synn
message: 「Health comes first! Want some milk?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll drink it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How can you drink that?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because Synn warmed it up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It just got lukewarm from his body heat, I'm telling you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Nanaka, I made you worry too. And it was delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. Well, I wasn't the one who made that oyakodon, though.」
Her dad, huh. Though I didn't get to eat any.

name: Azel
message: 「You brought it over. So, thank you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah. If Azel didn't get better soon, Synn might've played pranks on him while he was bedridden, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You didn't actually!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you talking about?!」
I'm sweating on my forehead even though it's winter!

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way I'd ever do something like that! Ahaha!」
Stop sweating! Quit pounding so hard, heart!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, right. You wouldn't have the guts for that, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Because I'm a chicken!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of pathetic stuff are you saying? Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is pretty pathetic. Ahahaha」

name: Azel
message: 「You aren't pathetic, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already know that much!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Well, I'm heading off to Prier」

name: Synn
message: 「Good luck!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Where's Azel?」
Before I knew it, my eyes were searching for her.

name: Sacchin
message: 「She took off somewhere the second lunch break started~」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
She did say she was almost done collecting photos of all the students, after all.

name: Sacchin
message: 「So Azel-chan gets there first~ Guess the match is decided~」

name: Synn
message: 「Gets where first?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Are you lonely without Azel-chan around~?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like we're parting forever... Huh? Nanaka's gone too?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan went off somewhere too~ Maybe the two of them met up~」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Maybe they're talking about something to do with you, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「As her best friend, you know~ I've kinda got mixed feelings about it~」

name: Synn
message: 「About what?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I said~ You oughta eat my bento and drop dead, Synn-kun~ Though if I did that, Nana-chan would shrivel me into a pickled plum, so I'll pass~」

name: Synn
message: 「You make zero sense, Sacchin. Not that that's anything new」

name: Paqy
message: 「You... only have sharp intuition in a few specific areas, huh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Praise me」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you want in a place like this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Phew」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To put it bluntly. Azel, do you like Synn?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not dislike him」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you ask such a thing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it comes to irrational impulses at our age, I figured it's probably love」

name: Azel
message: 「Absurd」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because it's irrational?」

name: Azel
message: 「Precisely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, none of that matters once you fall in love, right」

name: Azel
message: 「You say the exact same things as Ria」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As Senpai?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ria also deduced that I might be in love with Synn」

name: Azel
message: 「Even without any substantial evidence. It is illogical」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what's the truth?」

name: Azel
message: 「In the first place, this has nothing to do with you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It has everything to do with me」

name: Azel
message: 「Why」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I」
Nanaka took a single deep breath and declared.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I like Synn. I have for a long time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I've been in love with him for so, so long」

name: Azel
message: 「That has... nothing to do with me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do you like him or hate him?」

name: Azel
message: 「How should I know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I see. Got it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I won't hand him over to someone like you who can't even tell if you like or hate him」

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want」
Huh? Azel's not here.
Did she head home early?
She's probably organizing the photos or something.
